Bengaluru blends historic royal heritage, lush botanical gardens, and modern cultural monuments across its urban landscape. The following five landmarks are among the city's most visited and highly rated destinations.

node.content-desc: Table with 5 rows and 4 columns. Additional columns are available
Header. Attraction. Category. Rating. Key Highlights
Row 1. Attraction: Bangalore Palace. Category: Heritage & Architecture. Rating: 4.2 / 5.0. Key Highlights: Tudor Revival architecture, royal artifacts, manicured grounds
Row 2. Attraction: Lalbagh Botanical Garden. Category: Nature & Horticulture. Rating: 4.4 / 5.0. Key Highlights: Historic 1890 Glass House, century-old trees, serene lake
Row 3. Attraction: Cubbon Park. Category: Nature & Recreation. Rating: 4.6 / 5.0. Key Highlights: 300 acres of shaded green walking paths, colonial statues, library
Row 4. Attraction: ISKCON Temple Bangalore. Category: Culture & Spirituality. Rating: 4.7 / 5.0. Key Highlights: Grand hilltop shrine, ornate gopurams, tranquil prayer halls
Row 5. Attraction: Bannerghatta Biological Park. Category: Wildlife & Conservation. Rating: 4.3 / 5.0. Key Highlights: Wildlife safari, butterfly sanctuary, zoological rescue center
